title: DP19842 The Uncharted Waters of International Trade
title_zh: 国际贸易的未知水域
title_primary: 国际贸易的未知水域
title_secondary: DP19842 The Uncharted Waters of International Trade
authors: Pol Antràs
official: 官方在线 2025-01-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The field of international trade has undergone significant theoretical and empirical advancements over the last twenty-five years. A key breakthrough has been the emergence of firm-level approaches to studying exporting, importing, and global value chains. The field has also experienced a quantitative revolution, driven by medium-scale models that rapidly assess the implications of trade cost shocks on real income. Additionally, a branch of the empirical literature has unshackled itself from the discipline of theoretical frameworks and from traditional data sources. Yet, several underexplored areas, or `uncharted waters,' remain in international trade research. I outline new potential areas for theoretical research, including incorporating oligopolistic (strategic) behavior into core models, and fostering greater cross-disciplinary collaboration with other fields in economics and social sciences, such as behavioral economics or political science. I also discuss potential uncharted waters for empirical trade economists, while identifying potential new sources of data and ways in which official trade statistics could be improved. Finally, I explore how big data and artificial intelligence could reshape the design of international trade policy in coming years.
abstract_zh: 国际贸易领域在过去二十五年中经历了重大的理论与实证进展。一个关键突破是出现了以企业层面方法研究出口、进口及全球价值链的新视角。该领域还经历了一场定量革命，这得益于中型规模模型的发展，它们能迅速评估贸易成本冲击对实际收入的影响。此外，实证文献的一个分支已摆脱理论框架的束缚，并超越了传统数据来源的限制。然而，国际贸易研究中仍存在若干未被充分探索的领域，或称为“未知水域”。我概述了理论研究的潜在新领域，包括将寡头（策略性）行为融入核心模型，并促进与经济学及其他社会科学领域（如行为经济学或政治学）的跨学科合作。同时，我也讨论了实证贸易经济学家可能面临的未知水域，指出了潜在的新数据来源及官方贸易统计可改进之处。最后，我探讨了大数据与人工智能如何可能在未来几年重塑国际贸易政策的设计。

official: 官方在线 2025-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper reports results from a survey experiment comparing the effect of (the same) opinions expressed by male versus female experts. Members of the public were asked for their opinions on topical issues and shown the opinion of either a male or a female economist, all professors at leading US universities. We find, first, that experts can persuade members of the public – the opinions of individual expert economists have an effect on public opinion – and, second, that the opinions expressed by female economists are more persuasive than the same opinions expressed by male economists.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了一项调查实验结果，该实验比较了（相同的）观点由男性专家与女性专家表达时的效果差异。公众被询问其对热点议题的看法，并展示了一位男性或女性经济学家的观点，这些经济学家均为美国顶尖大学的教授。我们发现，首先，专家能够说服公众——个别经济学家专家的观点对公众舆论有影响；其次，女性经济学家表达的观点比男性经济学家表达的相同观点更具说服力。

title: Measurement Error when Estimating Covenant Slack and Violations
title_zh: 估计契约松弛与违约时的测量误差
title_primary: 估计契约松弛与违约时的测量误差
title_secondary: Measurement Error when Estimating Covenant Slack and Violations
authors: Scott Dyreng, Elia Ferracuti, Robert Hills, Matthew Kubic
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We collect quantitative (true thresholds and realizations) and qualitative (compliance status) covenant information from SEC filings to examine the accuracy of compliance estimates derived using data from commercial databases. Estimated covenant slack frequently overestimates covenant violations, and only rarely understates them, with this asymmetry holding for both qualitative and quantitative disclosers. The non-random structure of this measurement error has implications for research that relies on estimated violations or on precise measurement of covenant realizations near a threshold. Across our two samples of disclosers, we find evidence consistent with the debt covenant hypothesis for debt-to-EBITDA covenants once measurement error is considered. We also show that the lender forbearance rate declines sharply after correcting estimated violations for measurement error, and that true violations, but not estimated violations, are associated with negative stock market reactions and loan renegotiations. Finally, we investigate practical approaches to reduce measurement error.
abstract_zh: 我们从美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的备案文件中收集了定量（真实阈值及实现值）和定性（合规状态）的契约信息，以检验基于商业数据库数据得出的合规估计的准确性。估计的契约缓冲空间往往高估了契约违约情况，而很少低估，这种不对称性在定性披露者和定量披露者中均存在。这种测量误差的非随机结构对依赖估计违约或对阈值附近契约实现值精确测量的研究具有重要影响。在我们的两个披露者样本中，一旦考虑测量误差，我们发现与债务对EBITDA契约相关的债务契约假说证据一致。我们还表明，在纠正估计违约的测量误差后，贷款人容忍率显著下降，且真实违约（而非估计违约）与负面的股市反应及贷款重新谈判相关联。最后，我们探讨了减少测量误差的实用方法。

title: Enhancing financial inclusion measurements: A comparative analysis using unsupervised machine learning methods across Mexican municipalities
title_zh: 增强金融包容性测量：基于无监督机器学习方法的墨西哥各市镇比较分析
title_primary: 增强金融包容性测量：基于无监督机器学习方法的墨西哥各市镇比较分析
title_secondary: Enhancing financial inclusion measurements: A comparative analysis using unsupervised machine learning methods across Mexican municipalities
authors: René Cabral, Salvador Ulises Cadena Espinoza, Jong-Min Kim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While several different statistical methods have been employed to measure financial inclusion, two of the most frequently used in the literature are the adaptation of the Human Development Index (HDI) methodology proposed by Sarma (2008) and, more recently, the two-stage Principal Component Analysis (PCA) suggested by Cámara and Tuesta (2014). Employing a unique dataset on the access and usage of financial services across Mexican municipalities, this paper proposes the alternative use of two unsupervised Machine Learning (ML) methods: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and Kernel PCA (KPCA). To contrast the performance of the four different methods, we first cluster the municipalities using the K-Means algorithm. Thereafter, we focus our comparison of the indices produced by the four methods on the most financially excluded clusters, using standard ML performance metrics: precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy. Our results show that both HDI and NMF significantly outperform PCA-based methods across different thresholds at the bottom of the distribution. Several robustness checks confirm our findings. This result is particularly significant, as poverty alleviation, one of the primary targets of financial inclusion, can only be achieved successfully if policymakers accurately identify individuals and regions that are excluded or underserved by the financial sector.
abstract_zh: 虽然已有多种统计方法用于衡量金融包容性，但文献中最常用的两种方法是Sarma（2008）提出的对人类发展指数（HDI）方法的改编，以及近期Cámara和Tuesta（2014）提出的两阶段主成分分析（PCA）。利用墨西哥各城市金融服务的获取和使用情况的独特数据集，本文提出采用两种无监督机器学习（ML）方法的替代方案：非负矩阵分解（NMF）和核主成分分析（KPCA）。为对比这四种方法的性能，我们首先使用K-Means算法对城市进行聚类。随后，我们将比较重点放在四种方法生成的指数上，针对金融排斥最严重的聚类，采用标准机器学习性能指标：精确率、召回率、F1分数和准确率。结果表明，在分布底部的不同阈值下，HDI和NMF均显著优于基于PCA的方法。多项稳健性检验证实了我们的发现。这一结果尤为重要，因为扶贫作为金融包容性的主要目标之一，只有在政策制定者准确识别被金融部门排斥或服务不足的个人和地区时，才能成功实现。

title: The Digitalisation of Banking and Social Media: Implications for Deposit Pricing
title_zh: 银行业数字化与社交媒体：对存款定价的影响
title_primary: 银行业数字化与社交媒体：对存款定价的影响
title_secondary: The Digitalisation of Banking and Social Media: Implications for Deposit Pricing
authors: Michael Brei, Giulio Cornelli, Leonardo Gambacorta, Boris Hofmann
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the implications of two coincident digital trends — the digitalisation of banking and the widespread adoption of social media — for the pricing of deposits in the United States. Using branch-level data, we analyse how both trends interact to influence the level of deposit rates as well as their adjustment to changes in the policy rate. Our analysis distinguishes between traditional banks with physical branch networks and digital banks. Using panel regression analysis and local projections, we find that digital banks’ deposit rates are higher and more reactive to changes in policy rates, consistent with the view that their customers are more price sensitive. We further find that digital banks offer higher deposit rates and react more sharply to policy rate changes in counties with higher social media activity, as measured by Twitter usage, supporting the notion that high social media use further increases price sensitivity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了银行业数字化与社交媒体广泛普及这两大同步数字趋势对美国存款定价的影响。利用分行层面数据，我们分析了这两种趋势如何相互作用，影响存款利率水平及其对政策利率变动的调整。我们的分析区分了拥有实体分行网络的传统银行与数字银行。通过面板回归分析和局部投影法，我们发现数字银行的存款利率更高，且对政策利率变动的反应更为敏感，这与客户价格敏感度更高的观点一致。我们进一步发现，在社交媒体活跃度较高（以推特使用量衡量）的县，数字银行提供的存款利率更高，对政策利率变动的反应也更剧烈，这支持了高社交媒体使用进一步增强了价格敏感度的观点。

title: On the Strategyproof Allocation of Items Under a Budget Constraint
title_zh: 预算约束下物品的策略性配置研究
title_primary: 预算约束下物品的策略性配置研究
title_secondary: On the Strategyproof Allocation of Items Under a Budget Constraint
authors: Javier Cembrano, Max Klimm, Martin Knaack
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a mechanism-design-without-money setting in which a designer is interested in selecting items with maximum total value under a budget constraint. The items, however, are controlled by strategic agents who aim to maximize the total value of their selected items. This setting arises naturally when agencies select projects for funding, retailers choose products to stock, or hospitals schedule MRI scans. A mechanism governing the selection is strategyproof if no agent can benefit by hiding items they control from the mechanism. We are interested in mechanisms that are strategyproof and α-approximate, meaning that they always achieve at least an α-fraction of the optimal value for some α ∈ [0, 1]. First, we give a deterministic mechanism that is 1/ϕ 2-approximate, where 1/ϕ 2 ≈ 0.382 is the inverse of the square of the golden ratio. For the special case where all items have unit density, we design a deterministic 1/ϕ-approximate mechanism, where 1/ϕ ≈ 0.618. This result is tight as we show that no deterministic strategyproof mechanism with a better approximation exists. We further give randomized mechanisms with approximation guarantees of 1/2 for the general case and 2/3 for the unit-density case. For both the general and the unit-density settings, no randomized mechanism that is strategyproof in expectation can achieve an approximation guarantee better than 1 / ( 5 ϕ − 7 ) ≈ 0.917 .
abstract_zh: 我们研究一种无货币的机制设计场景，其中设计者旨在预算约束下选择总价值最大的项目。然而，这些项目由策略性代理人控制，他们旨在最大化其被选中项目的总价值。这一场景自然出现在机构选择资助项目、零售商决定库存商品或医院安排MRI扫描时。管理选择的机制是策略-proof的，如果没有任何代理人能通过向机制隐藏其控制的项目而获益。我们关注的是策略-proof且α-近似的机制，即对于某个α∈[0,1]，它们总能达到最优价值的至少α比例。首先，我们给出一个确定性机制，其近似比为1/φ²，其中1/φ²≈0.382是黄金比例平方的倒数。对于所有项目具有单位密度的特殊情况，我们设计了一个确定性1/φ近似机制，其中1/φ≈0.618。这一结果是紧致的，因为我们证明了不存在具有更好近似比的确定性策略-proof机制。我们进一步给出了随机机制，对于一般情况近似保证为1/2，对于单位密度情况为2/3。对于一般和单位密度设置，没有期望策略-proof的随机机制能实现优于1/(5φ−7)≈0.917的近似保证。

title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
title_zh: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析
title_primary: 关税传导至消费者价格的结构解析
title_secondary: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
authors: Mary Amiti, Sebastian Heise, David Weinstein
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
abstract_zh: 关税不仅提高了其所征税的进口商品的价格，也抬高了国内生产的商品价格——这一效应在标准的汇率传导估计中大多被忽视。通过研究2025年美国关税，我们发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。这些估计是相对于受关税影响较小的商品进行衡量的，并保持总体经济条件不变。直接效应占这一增幅的64%，因为关税提高了某一商品外国品种的消费者价格。其余36%则间接产生——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品成本，而国内生产商因面临来自高价进口商品的竞争减少而提高其加成率。直接效应传导迅速，因为关税几乎立即推高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九至十二个月才能通过供应链逐步显现。因此，关税对消费者的影响比仅考虑直接效应所暗示的更为显著且持续时间更长。

title: Drought, Structural Breaks, and the Economics of Public Land Grazing: Evidence From the Intermountain West
title_zh: 干旱、结构性突变与公共土地放牧经济学：来自美国西部山间地区的证据
title_primary: 干旱、结构性突变与公共土地放牧经济学：来自美国西部山间地区的证据
title_secondary: Drought, Structural Breaks, and the Economics of Public Land Grazing: Evidence From the Intermountain West
authors: Zuyi Wang, Man‐Keun Kim, Hernan A. Tejeda, Thomas R. Harris
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the decline in Bureau of Land Management (BLM) grazing allotments, authorized Animal Unit Months, across eight Intermountain states (Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming) from 1980 to 2022, examining the role of drought and structural change. Using outlier detection and structural break tests, we identify a concentrated regime shift in the early 2000s, with seven of eight states experiencing a statistically significant break between 2000 and 2003. Post‐break allotments declined by 11% regionally, ranging from 8% in New Mexico to 27% in Colorado. Outlier analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in the nature of shocks, with Idaho and Utah experiencing permanent level shifts, Colorado a temporary change, and Wyoming multiple shocks of all types. To quantify drought impacts, we estimate a fixed effects model with a lagged dependent variable and a state‐specific structural break dummy. Results show that a one‐unit decrease in the Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) reduces allotments by 0.5% immediately and by 3.6% in the long run under sustained drought. The break dummy is negative and highly significant, indicating a permanent 6.5% reduction in allotments following the early 2000s drought that is not explained by drought or market variables alone. This suggests that factors beyond drought have reduced grazing capacity. A sustained severe drought (three‐unit PDSI decrease) would permanently remove approximately 893,000 Animal Unit Months (AUMs) annually from the region, equivalent to 149,000–179,000 cow‐calf pairs and representing between $9 million and $27 million in lost forage value at private lease rates. These findings support reforms to drought relief programs to account for lagged and permanent effects, flexible permitting mechanisms for temporary drought, and long‐term adjustment assistance for permanent reductions. State‐specific heterogeneity in drought impacts implies that, while BLM already administers grazing at state and district levels, further differentiation of drought relief and permit flexibility based on state‐level vulnerabilities may improve effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了1980年至2022年间美国土地管理局（BLM）在八个山地州（亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内华达州、新墨西哥州、犹他州、怀俄明州）放牧配额（授权动物单位月）的下降趋势，并考察了干旱与结构性变化的作用。通过异常值检测与结构性断点检验，我们识别出21世纪初存在集中的制度变迁：八个州中有七个在2000年至2003年间出现统计显著的断点。断点后区域放牧配额平均下降11%，各州降幅从新墨西哥州的8%到科罗拉多州的27%不等。异常值分析揭示了冲击性质的显著异质性：爱达荷州与犹他州经历永久性水平位移，科罗拉多州为暂时性变化，而怀俄明州则遭遇多种类型的多重冲击。为量化干旱影响，我们构建了包含滞后因变量与州特定结构性断点虚拟变量的固定效应模型。结果显示：帕尔默干旱指数（PDSI）每下降1个单位，放牧配额在短期内立即减少0.5%，在持续干旱条件下长期累计减少3.6%。断点虚拟变量为负且高度显著，表明21世纪初干旱后放牧配额永久性减少6.5%，这一降幅无法仅由干旱或市场变量解释，暗示干旱以外的因素削弱了放牧承载力。持续严重干旱（PDSI下降3个单位）将导致该区域每年永久性减少约89.3万动物单位月（AUMs），相当于14.9万至17.9万对母牛-牛犊组合，按私人租赁费率计算，牧草价值损失达900万至2700万美元。这些发现支持对干旱救济计划进行改革，以纳入滞后与永久性效应、建立临时干旱的灵活许可机制，并为永久性减少提供长期调整援助。干旱影响的州际异质性表明，尽管BLM已在州与地区层面实施放牧管理，但基于州级脆弱性进一步差异化干旱救济与许可灵活性，可能提升政策有效性。

title: Can Maternal Education Improve Children's Dietary Diversity and Nutritional Outcomes? Evidence from the 2003 Education Reform in Kenya
title_zh: 母亲教育能否改善儿童的膳食多样性和营养结果？来自肯尼亚2003年教育改革的证据
title_primary: 母亲教育能否改善儿童的膳食多样性和营养结果？来自肯尼亚2003年教育改革的证据
title_secondary: Can Maternal Education Improve Children's Dietary Diversity and Nutritional Outcomes? Evidence from the 2003 Education Reform in Kenya
authors: Khan, Sana, Giannelli, Gianna, Ferrone, Lucia
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Education is widely associated with better health outcomes, but whether this relationship is causal remains unclear, especially in low-income countries. This study examines the causal effect of maternal education on child nutrition and dietary diversity in Kenya. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, with exposure to the 2003 school reform as an instrument for educational attainment, the analysis finds that an additional year of maternal schooling significantly improves children's nutritional status and dietary diversity. Positive effects are observed for both boys and girls, although they are slightly stronger for boys. The results are robust to a range of sensitivity tests. Further analysis suggests that maternal education improves child health through several channels, including delayed first birth, fewer children under age five, higher paternal education, greater use of prenatal care, increased access to information through newspapers and television, improved literacy, and higher employment rates among mothers. These findings indicate that expanding educational opportunities for girls can be an effective policy tool for improving child nutrition and feeding practices in developing countries such as Kenya.
abstract_zh: 教育通常与更好的健康结果相关联，但这种关系是否具有因果性仍不明确，尤其是在低收入国家。本研究探讨了肯尼亚母亲教育对儿童营养和膳食多样性的因果效应。采用模糊断点回归设计，以2003年学校改革作为教育程度的工具变量，分析发现母亲每多接受一年教育，能显著改善儿童的营养状况和膳食多样性。对男孩和女孩均观察到积极影响，但对男孩的影响略强。结果在一系列敏感性检验中保持稳健。进一步分析表明，母亲教育通过多个渠道改善儿童健康，包括推迟首次生育、减少五岁以下子女数量、提高父亲教育水平、增加产前护理使用、通过报纸和电视获取更多信息、提升识字率以及提高母亲就业率。这些发现表明，扩大女孩教育机会可以成为改善肯尼亚等发展中国家儿童营养和喂养实践的有效政策工具。

title: Does data exchange platform boost green innovation?—Empirical evidence from heavily polluting enterprises with the integration of machine learning and econometric methods
title_zh: 数据交换平台是否促进了绿色创新？——基于机器学习与计量方法整合的高污染企业实证证据
title_primary: 数据交换平台是否促进了绿色创新？——基于机器学习与计量方法整合的高污染企业实证证据
title_secondary: Does data exchange platform boost green innovation?—Empirical evidence from heavily polluting enterprises with the integration of machine learning and econometric methods
authors: Yuhang Xia, Huibo Zhong, Zechen Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Data Exchange Platform (DEP) establishment on the green innovation of heavily polluting enterprises, with a focus on spatial spillover effects. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2014 to 2023, we employ a hybrid framework that combines machine learning techniques, causal econometric models with instrumental variables, and spatial econometric and regression methods. The results indicate that DEP significantly promotes green innovation in host cities. The main empirically verified mechanism lies in restraining greenwashing through enhanced data transparency. However, at the spatial level, DEP shows a significant negative spatial spillover effect under the baseline spatial weight matrix, indicating a possible resource siphon effect that concentrates data and innovation resources in platform-hosting locations. Marked regional heterogeneity is observed: local effects dominate in the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei and Pearl River Delta regions, while the Yangtze River Delta exhibits positive spillovers due to stronger regional integration. Firm-level analyses further reveal that DEP effects are strongest for firms in highly concentrated markets, small and medium-sized enterprises, and mature firms. Overall, the findings highlight data as a core production factor in green innovation and emphasize the need for spatially coordinated data governance to mitigate siphon effects and promote regional collaborative innovation. KEYWORDS: Data exchange platform green innovation spatial spillover effect XGBoost-SHAP model Geographical Gaussian Process Regression (GGPR) JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q55 R11
abstract_zh: 本文研究了数据交易平台（DEP）的建立对重污染企业绿色创新的影响，重点关注空间溢出效应。基于2014至2023年中国上市公司面板数据，我们采用融合机器学习技术、工具变量因果计量模型以及空间计量与回归方法的混合框架。结果表明，DEP显著促进了所在城市的绿色创新。实证验证的主要机制在于通过增强数据透明度抑制漂绿行为。然而，在空间层面，基准空间权重矩阵下DEP呈现显著的负向空间溢出效应，表明可能存在资源虹吸效应，即数据和创新资源向平台所在地集中。区域异质性显著：京津冀和珠三角地区以本地效应为主，而长三角地区因更强的区域一体化表现出正向溢出效应。企业层面分析进一步揭示，DEP效应在高度集中市场中的企业、中小企业以及成熟企业中最为显著。总体而言，研究结果凸显了数据作为绿色创新核心生产要素的作用，并强调需实施空间协调的数据治理以缓解虹吸效应，促进区域协同创新。关键词：数据交易平台 绿色创新 空间溢出效应 XGBoost-SHAP模型 地理高斯过程回归（GGPR） JEL分类：Q55 R11

title: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据
title_primary: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据
title_secondary: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
authors: Nobuyuki Hanaki, Yuta Shimodaira
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 一些研究者认为，对财富积累的偏好是导致日本经济长期停滞的原因之一。此类偏好的一个理论含义——特别是假设累积财富的边际效用存在严格正下限而消费的边际效用不存在这一假设——会导致财富不平等扩大。我们通过实验室实验诱导被试产生财富积累偏好，对该理论预测进行检验。结果发现该预测得到部分支持：当初始不平等程度较高时，财富不平等会扩大；但当初始不平等程度较低时则不会。这是因为高财富参与者比低财富参与者更倾向于过度消费，这在一定程度上抵消了诱导的财富积累偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等扩大的影响有限。

title: Increasing Inventories: The Role of Delivery Times
title_zh: 库存增加：交货时间的作用
title_primary: 库存增加：交货时间的作用
title_secondary: Increasing Inventories: The Role of Delivery Times
authors: Carreras-Valle, Maria-Jose
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Inventories mitigate the risk of global sourcing. I present new evidence of the rise in U.S. manufacturing inventories after 2005, reversing a declining trend that lasted for decades. I examine this trend in a model of delivery times and inventories. The rise in global sourcing lead to longer and more volatile delivery times, which increase a firm’s exposure to risk. Thus, firms hold more inventories. I find the rise in global sourcing accounts for 86% of the rise in inventories. Further, a globalized economy that uses more foreign inputs trades-off the increase in output at the cost of increased macroeconomic volatility.
abstract_zh: 库存缓解了全球采购的风险。本文提供了2005年后美国制造业库存上升的新证据，这一趋势逆转了持续数十年的下降态势。我通过构建交货时间与库存模型对此趋势展开研究。全球采购的扩张导致交货时间延长且波动加剧，从而增加了企业面临的风险敞口。因此，企业倾向于持有更多库存。研究发现，全球采购的扩张解释了库存上升的86%。此外，使用更多外国投入品的全球化经济在提升产出的同时，也以宏观经济波动加剧为代价。

title: Risk Perceptions and Protective Behaviors at the Onset and Outset of the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: COVID-19疫情初期与后期的风险感知与防护行为
title_primary: COVID-19疫情初期与后期的风险感知与防护行为
title_secondary: Risk Perceptions and Protective Behaviors at the Onset and Outset of the COVID-19 Pandemic
authors: Joan Costa-i-Font, Melcior Rossello-Roig, Caroline Rudisil, Luca Salmasi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the formation of risk perceptions— subjective probability beliefs— of three adverse events—COVID-19 contagion, influenza contagion, and food poisoning—at the onset and outset of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, using survey data. We show that perceived risk levels for COVID-19 are similar to those for influenza but are not significantly influenced by proximity to infection and are shaped instead by an individual's gender, education, and employment status. Using an instrumental variable strategy, we assess whether these perceptions influence a number of protective behaviors. Although risk perceptions are associated with various protective behaviors, we only find a causal impact in increasing the likelihood of phone or online medical consultations by only about a percentage point
abstract_zh: 我们利用调查数据，研究了美国新冠疫情初期与暴发阶段，民众对三种不良事件——新冠病毒感染、流感感染及食物中毒——的风险感知（即主观概率信念）的形成机制。研究表明，民众对新冠病毒的风险感知水平与流感相似，但并未显著受到感染邻近性的影响，而是由个体的性别、教育程度及就业状况所塑造。通过工具变量策略，我们评估了这些风险感知是否影响多种防护行为。尽管风险感知与各类防护行为存在关联，但我们仅发现其对增加电话或在线医疗咨询概率具有因果效应，且该效应仅约一个百分点。

title: Multi-objective land use optimization coupling spatialized shuffled frog leaping algorithm with multi-level agent
title_zh: 耦合空间化混合蛙跳算法与多层级智能体的多目标土地利用优化
title_primary: 耦合空间化混合蛙跳算法与多层级智能体的多目标土地利用优化
title_secondary: Multi-objective land use optimization coupling spatialized shuffled frog leaping algorithm with multi-level agent
authors: Bowen Pang, Yaolin Liu, Sui Liu, Zhaomin Tong, Yifan Xie 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land use optimization is a crucial method to reduce carbon emission and promote sustainable development, calling for advanced fine-grained modeling to address complex human-land conflicts. However, existing models still exhibit limitations in internalizing geographical rules, constructing multi-level interaction mechanisms, and bridging the spatial-scale mismatch between global and local optimization. Therefore, this study constructs a multi-objective optimization scenario under low-carbon development, proposing a novel coupling model (SSFLA-MLAS), which integrates a spatialized shuffled frog leaping algorithm (SSFLA) with a multi-level agent system (MLAS). The integration resolves cross-scale spatial coordination through a nested coupling architecture, while simultaneously accounting for multi-level interactive decision simulation and multi-objective heuristic search. The case study in Huangpi District demonstrates that: (1) SSFLA-MLAS outperforms single algorithms in effectiveness and efficiency, achieving overall objective 3.4%, 32.5% and 26.5% greater than SSFLA, MLAS and multi-agent system (MAS). (2) MLAS improves the comprehensive landscape pattern index by 26.4% over MAS while aligning spatial layouts with development strategies. (3) SSFLA-MLAS demonstrates remarkable optimization results, improving economic, social and ecological objectives by 5.01%, 2.87% and 0.74%, while enhancing net carbon sink by 1.38%. The model not only offers intelligent support for sustainable land-use planning, but also advances the methodological integration of spatial optimization modeling through coupling global search with local simulation. abstract_zh: 土地利用优化是减少碳排放、促进可持续发展的关键手段，亟需先进的细粒度建模来解决复杂的人地冲突。然而，现有模型在内部化地理规则、构建多层次交互机制以及弥合全局与局部优化之间的空间尺度错配方面仍存在局限。为此，本研究在低碳发展背景下构建了多目标优化情景，提出了一种新型耦合模型（SSFLA-MLAS），该模型将空间化混合蛙跳算法（SSFLA）与多层次智能体系统（MLAS）相结合。通过嵌套耦合架构，该集成解决了跨尺度空间协调问题，同时兼顾了多层次交互决策模拟与多目标启发式搜索。以黄陂区为案例的研究表明：（1）SSFLA-MLAS在有效性和效率上均优于单一算法，综合目标分别比SSFLA、MLAS和多智能体系统（MAS）高出3.4%、32.5%和26.5%。（2）MLAS相较于MAS将综合景观格局指数提升了26.4%，同时使空间布局与发展战略保持一致。（3）SSFLA-MLAS展现出显著的优化效果，经济、社会和生态目标分别提升了5.01%、2.87%和0.74%，净碳汇增加了1.38%。该模型不仅为可持续土地利用规划提供了智能支持，还通过将全局搜索与局部模拟相耦合，推进了空间优化建模的方法论整合。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图片（195KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图片

title: Design Strategies for Networked Experiments via Interference Balancing
title_primary: Design Strategies for Networked Experiments via Interference Balancing
authors: Haoyu Yang, Yichen Qin, Yan Yu, YK Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Randomized experiments are widely used to estimate the causal effects of treatment or intervention across various scientific fields. Nowadays, numerous experiments are conducted in network settings where the outcome of one unit depends not only on its own treatment but also on the treatments of other units within the network. This phenomenon, known as network interference, poses significant challenges for experimental design. Existing randomization methods often neglect interference or rely on strict assumptions, such as homogeneous peers or linearity in peer interference. We introduce two innovative and easy-to-implement randomization designs for estimating direct treatment effects in the presence of heterogeneous or nonlinear network interference: network interference balancing rerandomization (NetRR) and network maximized matching randomization (NetMM). We explore the theoretical properties of two widely used estimators under these proposed randomization designs. Numerical results in the simulated experiment and the real-world social network experiment confirm the desirable performance of the proposed methods. Additionally, we discuss the trade-off between the risks associated with model assumptions and the feasibility of the randomization design.

title: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
title_zh: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验
title_primary: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验
title_secondary: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
authors: Agata Farina, Guillaume R Fréchette, Alessandro Ispano, Alessandro Lizzeri, Jacopo Perego
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behavior because it is far more prevalent than concealment.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在模型中，知情发送者旨在通过披露从更大可用证据池中选出的可验证证据来影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用了该模型丰富的比较静态分析，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。研究结果证实了理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主要的扭曲因素。我们还发现了与理论的偏离：部分发送者存在“欺骗厌恶”倾向，其沟通程度高于理论预测；接收者对隐瞒和选择证据的反应均过于乐观，且误差幅度相似。然而，由于选择比隐瞒更为普遍，它在接收者行为中造成了更大的整体扭曲。

title: The Labor Market Value of Community College Bachelor’s Degrees: Initial Evidence from a Resume Audit Study in Early Childhood Education
title_zh: 社区大学学士学位的劳动力市场价值：基于早期儿童教育简历审计研究的初步证据
title_primary: 社区大学学士学位的劳动力市场价值：基于早期儿童教育简历审计研究的初步证据
title_secondary: The Labor Market Value of Community College Bachelor’s Degrees: Initial Evidence from a Resume Audit Study in Early Childhood Education
authors: Riley K. Acton, Camila Morales, Julia A. Turner, Lois Miller, Kalena Cortes
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Community colleges are more financially, academically, and geographically accessible than four-year institutions. Yet despite most community college students intending to earn a bachelor’s degree, few successfully transfer and complete one. Community College Baccalaureate (CCB) programs have emerged as an alternative pathway, allowing community colleges to confer bachelor’s degrees directly. However, little is known about how employers value these credentials in the labor market. To address this question, we conduct the first resume audit study of CCB degrees, submitting fictitious applications to real job vacancies while experimentally varying applicants’ educational credentials, degree-granting institutions, and demographic signals. In this pilot study, we focus on the early childhood education (ECE) labor market, a rapidly growing CCB field characterized by labor shortages and increasing educational requirements. We find that employers view CCB degrees similarly to both traditional bachelor’s and associate degrees, with statistically indistinguishable interview-request rates across degree types. A text analysis of employer callback messages reveals little evidence that employers communicate differently with CCB applicants, while a net-price simulation suggests that sticker-price comparisons substantially overstate the affordability advantage of CCB programs. Together, these findings provide new evidence on the labor market value and affordability of CCB degrees and inform an ongoing large-scale audit study across additional fields and labor markets.
abstract_zh: 社区学院在财务、学业和地理可及性方面均优于四年制院校。然而，尽管大多数社区学院学生有意获得学士学位，但成功转学并完成学业者寥寥无几。社区学院学士学位项目作为替代路径应运而生，允许社区学院直接授予学士学位。但鲜有研究探讨雇主在劳动力市场中对这类学历的认可程度。为解答这一问题，我们开展了首项针对社区学院学士学位的简历审计研究，通过向真实职位空缺提交虚构申请，实验性调整申请人的教育背景、学位授予机构及人口统计学信号。在本试点研究中，我们聚焦于早期儿童教育劳动力市场——该领域是社区学院学士学位快速发展的方向，具有劳动力短缺与教育要求持续提升的双重特征。研究发现，雇主对社区学院学士学位的认可度与传统学士学位及副学士学位相当，不同学位类型对应的面试邀请率在统计上无显著差异。对雇主回访信息的文本分析显示，雇主与社区学院学士学位申请者的沟通方式几乎不存在差异；而净价格模拟表明，标价比较会显著高估社区学院学士学位项目的经济可负担性。综合来看，这些发现为社区学院学士学位的劳动力市场价值与可负担性提供了新证据，并为正在开展的跨领域、跨劳动力市场的大规模审计研究奠定基础。

title: Can realized covariance measure improve VaR forecasting of China’s new energy and financial markets? ——Evidence from the A-MRS-Copula model
title_zh: 实现协方差能否改进中国新能源与金融市场的VaR预测？——来自A-MRS-Copula模型的证据
title_primary: 实现协方差能否改进中国新能源与金融市场的VaR预测？——来自A-MRS-Copula模型的证据
title_secondary: Can realized covariance measure improve VaR forecasting of China’s new energy and financial markets? ——Evidence from the A-MRS-Copula model
authors: Shang Jin, Zhenlong Chen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a new adaptive Markov regime-switching copula (A-MRS-Copula) model based on the realized covariance measures to enhance the prediction accuracy of portfolio risk of China’ s new energy and financial markets. More specifically, the model relaxes the static transition probability condition of the traditional MRS-Copula model, allowing the copula parameters to vary adaptively based on high-frequency dependence information between assets. Furthermore, given the leverage effect prevalent in financial markets, we employ realized semicovariances as proxies for intraday dependencies in our modelling process. This approach improves the ability of the model to capture asset leverage effect and accurately depict dynamic dependence. Empirical results show that the A-MRS-Copula model exhibits statistically significant improvement in forecasting portfolio risk in new energy markets and other markets. Finally, robustness tests confirm that the new model outperforms the MRS-Copula model in terms of different data, copula function settings, prediction evaluation methods and rolling window.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于已实现协方差测度的新型自适应马尔可夫机制转换Copula（A-MRS-Copula）模型，旨在提升中国新能源与金融市场投资组合风险的预测精度。具体而言，该模型放宽了传统MRS-Copula模型的静态转移概率条件，允许Copula参数根据资产间高频依赖信息进行自适应调整。此外，针对金融市场普遍存在的杠杆效应，我们在建模过程中采用已实现半协方差作为日内依赖关系的代理变量，从而增强模型捕捉资产杠杆效应与准确刻画动态依赖结构的能力。实证结果表明，A-MRS-Copula模型在新能源市场与其他市场的投资组合风险预测中具有统计显著的改进效果。最后，稳健性检验证实，该新模型在不同数据、Copula函数设定、预测评估方法及滚动窗口条件下均优于MRS-Copula模型。

title: Innovation and Startup Acquisition
title_zh: 创新与初创企业收购
title_primary: 创新与初创企业收购
title_secondary: Innovation and Startup Acquisition
authors: Marc Bourreau, Axel Gautier
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we consider two platforms that compete for the development of a new product to integrate into their ecosystems. The new product can be developed either in-house by the platforms or by an independent startup active only in the technology market. The technology of the startup can be transferred to the platforms either exclusively (startup acquisition) or non-exclusively (licensing). A platform acquires the startup’s technology either because it failed to develop the technology itself or to prevent a rival from acquiring it (a killer acquisition). The presence of the startup affects the platforms’ R&D efforts through an insurance effect, which reduces the cost of failed innovation, and a competition effect, which diminishes the returns to innovation. The magnitude of these effects depends on the merger policy decided by the competition authorities. We show that allowing acquisitions stimulates platform innovation, but at the cost of a more concentrated market structure.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了两个平台为将新产品整合进其生态系统而展开的竞争。新产品既可由平台内部开发，也可由一家仅在技术市场活跃的独立初创企业开发。初创企业的技术可以排他性（即初创企业被收购）或非排他性（即许可）方式转让给平台。平台收购初创企业技术的原因，要么是自身开发失败，要么是为了阻止竞争对手获得该技术（即“杀手级收购”）。初创企业的存在通过保险效应（降低创新失败的成本）和竞争效应（减少创新的回报）影响平台的研发投入。这些效应的强弱取决于竞争当局制定的并购政策。我们表明，允许收购会刺激平台创新，但代价是市场结构更加集中。

title: To fail or not to fail? Disentangling capital and liquidity effects on US banks default
title_zh: 失败还是不失败？资本与流动性对美国银行违约影响的解构
title_primary: 失败还是不失败？资本与流动性对美国银行违约影响的解构
title_secondary: To fail or not to fail? Disentangling capital and liquidity effects on US banks default
authors: Pierre Durand, Gaëtan Le Quang, Arnold Vialfont
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a database comprising US bank balance sheet variables and the list of failed banks as provided by the FDIC, we run various models to compute banks’ default probability in order to assess the impact of capital and liquidity on it. A companion website is available to execute the associated code on a https://github.com/Durand-LeQuang-Vialfont/banksdefaultGithub repository. We provide evidence that 1) capital is a stronger predictor of default than liquidity, 2) Basel III capital requirements should be set at a higher level. Having a look at the impact of the interaction between capital and liquidity on the probability of default, we indeed show that the influence of the former completely outweighs that of the latter. Concerning the impact of capital ratios on the probability of default, we provide evidence that increasing the former allows reducing the latter up to a certain point. More precisely, it seems that when the risk-weighted ratio is around 15% and the simple leverage ratio around 10%, the probability of default reaches it lowest value. These results therefore call for strengthening capital requirements while at the same time releasing the regulatory pressure put on liquidity, especially for small banks.
abstract_zh: 利用包含美国银行资产负债表变量及FDIC提供的倒闭银行名单的数据库，我们运行多种模型计算银行的违约概率，以评估资本和流动性对其的影响。配套网站可在https://github.com/Durand-LeQuang-Vialfont/banksdefaultGithub 仓库中执行相关代码。我们提供的证据表明：1）资本比流动性更能预测违约，2）巴塞尔III的资本要求应设定在更高水平。通过考察资本与流动性交互作用对违约概率的影响，我们确实发现前者的影响完全超过了后者。关于资本比率对违约概率的影响，我们提供的证据显示，提高前者可以在一定程度上降低后者。更具体地说，当风险加权比率约为15%且简单杠杆比率约为10%时，违约概率达到最低值。因此，这些结果呼吁加强资本要求，同时减轻对流动性的监管压力，尤其是对小型银行而言。

title: The effect of emergency financial assistance on employment and earnings
title_zh: 紧急财政援助对就业和收入的影响
title_primary: 紧急财政援助对就业和收入的影响
title_secondary: The effect of emergency financial assistance on employment and earnings
authors: Daniel Hungerman, David Phillips, Kevin Rinz, James Sullivan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the labor supply effects of short-term income transfers for families experiencing a housing crisis. We link callers to an emergency assistance homelessness prevention hotline to their federal tax records and measure their earnings in the years surrounding their calls. Our methodology exploits quasi-random variation in the availability of assistance to compare similar families receiving and not receiving funds. Looking up to four years post-assistance, we find evidence, especially for the lowest earners, of earnings gains, and overall we find no evidence that assistance lowers earnings. Our results indicate that any income effect of temporary transfers for those in crisis is minimal and that these targeted transfers may convey labor market benefits for the poorest of the poor.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了面临住房危机的家庭获得短期收入转移对劳动力供给的影响。我们将拨打紧急援助无家可归预防热线的来电者与其联邦税务记录相链接，并衡量他们在来电前后几年的收入情况。我们的方法利用援助可用性的准随机变化，比较接受与未接受资金的家庭。在援助后长达四年的观察期内，我们发现，尤其是对于最低收入群体，存在收入增长的证据，且总体而言，我们没有发现援助会降低收入的证据。我们的结果表明，对于处于危机中的家庭，临时转移支付的任何收入效应都微乎其微，而这些有针对性的转移支付可能为最贫困群体带来劳动力市场收益。

title: The Role of Firms and Job Mobility in the Assimilation of Immigrants: Former Soviet Union Jews in Israel 1990–2019,
title_zh: 企业与工作流动性在移民融入中的作用：1990–2019年以色列的前苏联犹太人
title_primary: 企业与工作流动性在移民融入中的作用：1990–2019年以色列的前苏联犹太人
title_secondary: The Role of Firms and Job Mobility in the Assimilation of Immigrants: Former Soviet Union Jews in Israel 1990–2019,
authors: Jaime Arellano-Bover, Shmuel San
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how job mobility, firms, and firm-ladder climbing can shape immigrants’ labor market success. Our context is the mass migration of former Soviet Union Jews to Israel during the 1990s. Once in Israel, these immigrants faced none of the legal barriers that are typically posed by migration regulations around the world, offering a unique backdrop to study undistorted immigrants’ job mobility and resulting unconstrained assimilation. Rich administrative data allows us to follow immigrants for up to three decades after arrival. Immigrants experienced large initial wage gaps relative to natives—57% for men and 47% for women—and 12%–20% of these gaps are explained by differential sorting across firms and differential pay-setting within firms. The wage gap closes only after 27–29 years, and much of this convergence is driven by immigrants’ differential climbing of the firm ladder: immigrants are more mobile and experience faster upward moves, even in the long term. As such, firm-to-firm mobility is a key driver of these immigrants’ long-run prosperity. Lastly, we quantify a previously undocumented job utility gap when accounting for non-wage amenities. Upon arrival, immigrants’ non-pay amenities were lower by 0.38 (men) and 0.94 (women) native standard deviations. As such, amenities exacerbate immigrant-native disparities based on pay alone.
abstract_zh: 本文研究职业流动性、企业以及企业阶梯攀升如何影响移民在劳动力市场中的成功。我们的研究背景是20世纪90年代前苏联犹太人向以色列的大规模移民。抵达以色列后，这些移民未面临全球移民法规通常设置的法律障碍，这为研究不受扭曲的移民职业流动性及其导致的无约束同化提供了独特背景。丰富的行政数据使我们能够追踪移民抵达后长达三十年的情况。移民最初面临相对于本地人的巨大工资差距——男性为57%，女性为47%——其中12%至20%的差距可由企业在不同群体间的差异化配置以及企业内部差异化薪酬设定解释。工资差距需27至29年才能弥合，而这一趋同过程很大程度上源于移民在企业阶梯上的差异化攀升：移民流动性更强，且即使在长期内也能实现更快的向上流动。因此，企业间流动性是这些移民长期经济繁荣的关键驱动力。最后，我们在考虑非工资福利后，量化了此前未被记录的职位效用差距。抵达时，移民的非薪酬福利比本地人低0.38（男性）和0.94（女性）个标准差。因此，福利因素加剧了仅基于薪酬的移民与本地人之间的差距。

title: Size‐based regulation and water quality: Evidence from the Iowa hog industry
title_zh: 基于规模的监管与水质：来自爱荷华州生猪产业的证据
title_primary: 基于规模的监管与水质：来自爱荷华州生猪产业的证据
title_secondary: Size‐based regulation and water quality: Evidence from the Iowa hog industry
authors: Chen‐Ti Chen, Gabriel E. Lade, John M. Crespi, David A. Keiser
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The growing prevalence of animal feeding operations (AFOs) in the United States raises concerns among the public and regulators about their impact on local environmental quality. By linking historical regulatory records of AFOs in Iowa to downstream surface water pollution monitors, this paper studies the effects of the 2003 Clean Water Act regulations that targeted water pollution from the largest hog AFOs. The regulation decreased ammonia concentrations downstream of large hog AFOs by 6–8 percentage points. We find limited to no evidence of improvement for dissolved oxygen and phosphorus concentrations. Pollution reductions are largest during heavy precipitation months, consistent with the regulations reducing on-site spills and nutrient runoff from local fields. However, we find that pollution increased downstream from mid-sized hog AFOs, which were exempt from the updated regulations. Given the growth in the number of mid-sized facilities relative to large AFOs, we estimate that the regulation had little discernible impact on overall water quality.
abstract_zh: 美国动物饲养操作（AFOs）日益增多，引起了公众和监管机构对其对当地环境质量影响的担忧。通过将爱荷华州AFOs的历史监管记录与下游地表水污染监测数据相连接，本文研究了2003年《清洁水法》针对最大规模猪类AFOs水污染的规定效果。该规定使大型猪类AFOs下游的氨氮浓度降低了6至8个百分点。我们发现，对于溶解氧和磷浓度的改善证据有限或不存在。污染减少在强降水月份最为显著，这与规定减少了现场泄漏和当地农田养分径流的情况相符。然而，我们发现，在未受新规约束的中型猪类AFOs下游，污染有所增加。鉴于中型设施数量相对于大型AFOs的增长，我们估计该规定对整体水质的影响微乎其微。

title: A Housing Portfolio Channel of QE Transmission
title_zh: 量化宽松传导的住房投资组合渠道
title_primary: 量化宽松传导的住房投资组合渠道
title_secondary: A Housing Portfolio Channel of QE Transmission
authors: DOMINIK BODDIN, DANIEL MARCEL TE KAAT, CHANG MA, ALESSANDRO REBUCCI
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-02-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We document a housing portfolio channel of monetary policy transmission using German household data in a difference‐in‐differences setting around the ECB's implementation of quantitative easing (QE) in 2015. We find that QE encourages households with larger initial bond positions to rebalance more toward second homes. Rebalancing is especially pronounced among higher income and church‐affiliated households with stronger tax incentives to purchase and rent out properties. We also show that, in regions more exposed to this channel, house prices increase more than rents, and sale listings decrease more than rental ones, suggesting that the rental supply may increase in response to QE.
abstract_zh: 我们利用德国住户数据，在2015年欧洲央行实施量化宽松（QE）前后的双重差分设定中，记录了货币政策传导的住房投资组合渠道。我们发现，量化宽松促使初始债券持有规模较大的家庭更多地向第二套住房进行再平衡。这种再平衡在高收入及与教会关联的家庭中尤为显著，这些家庭在购房和出租房产方面享有更强的税收激励。我们还表明，在受该渠道影响更大的地区，房价相对于租金上涨更多，销售挂牌量相对于租赁挂牌量下降更多，这表明量化宽松可能促使租赁供给增加。

title: Left Over or Opting Out? Squeeze, Mismatch and Surplus in Chinese Marriage Markets
title_zh: 剩男还是主动退出？中国婚姻市场中的挤压、错配与剩余
title_primary: 剩男还是主动退出？中国婚姻市场中的挤压、错配与剩余
title_secondary: Left Over or Opting Out? Squeeze, Mismatch and Surplus in Chinese Marriage Markets
authors: Pauline Rossi, Yun Xiao, Stefano Carattini, Hanwei Huang, Frank Pisch 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Marriage is declining in China. Among singles, the probability of marrying in 2019 was half that of marrying in 1999. We estimate a Choo and Siow (2006b) model using census data to quantify the relative roles of changes in population structure and changes in marital surplus, i.e., the value of marriage. We find that the increase in the supply of educated people explains half of the decline, partly due to a mismatch between highly-educated women and less-educated men. The deterioration of female-to-male ratio, known as marriage squeeze, explains an additional 13% for men. The decrease in surplus accounts for the remainder.
abstract_zh: 中国的婚姻率正在下降。在单身人群中，2019年结婚的概率仅为1999年的一半。我们利用人口普查数据估计了Choo和Siow（2006b）模型，以量化人口结构变化与婚姻剩余（即婚姻价值）变化的相对作用。研究发现，受教育人口增加解释了婚姻率下降的一半原因，部分源于高学历女性与低学历男性之间的婚配错位。女性与男性比例恶化（即婚姻挤压）对男性婚姻率下降的额外解释力为13%。剩余部分则由婚姻剩余减少所解释。
